task_categories.CRITICAL_BLOCKER: MUST resolve before any Phase 1 execution
task_categories.PHASE_1_CORE: Core Phase 1 functionality (landing page, blog, email)
task_categories.PHASE_2_DEFERRED: Multi-artist scaling, advanced features (defer post MVP)

tasks.title: Resolve Service Topology (LitElement ↔ Railway ↔ FastAPI)
tasks.description: 3-way coupling decision: how do LitElement Web Components communicate with Railway microservices? Admin panel hosted where? API gateway routing?
tasks.notes: Serigne + Opus 4-6 deep-dive session. Decision locks all downstream architecture.

tasks.title: Lock Album Upload Flow (Phase 1 vs Phase 2)
tasks.description: Define Phase 1 scope: admin-only upload (single artist) vs Phase 2 (multi-artist upload). Current BBBA decision incomplete on user flow.
tasks.notes: Decision: Phase 1 = admin-only (Allyson interface), Phase 2 = generalized multi-artist. Lock scope NOW.

tasks.title: Build Landing Page (Hero, CTA, Album Grid)
tasks.description: Hero section with artist bio, call-to-action (email signup), featured album grid with 3–5 albums. Responsive design (mobile-first).

tasks.title: Build Blog List Page + Blog Post Template
tasks.description: Blog list (chronological, pagination), individual blog post pages. Markdown parsing (posts stored in CMS or filesystem). Author byline, publish date, metadata.

tasks.title: Build Photo Gallery Page (Albums, Carousel, Lightbox)
tasks.description: Gallery page with album cards, carousel for featured images, lightbox for full-screen viewing. Metadata per image (caption, date, location).

tasks.title: Build Navigation + Footer (Consistent across all pages)
tasks.description: Primary nav (Home, Blog, Gallery, About, Contact), mobile hamburger menu, footer with social links, copyright, sitemap link.

tasks.title: Build Admin Panel (Album Upload Interface — Phase 1: Admin-Only)
tasks.description: Admin-only interface for Allyson to upload albums (name, description, cover image, track list). Phase 1 = single-artist auth (Allyson), Phase 2 = generalize. JWT token in localStorage (phase 1 acceptable).

tasks.title: Implement Album + Track Database Schema (Prisma)
tasks.description: Finalize Prisma schema for Album (name, description, cover_image_url, release_date, artist_id) and Track (title, duration, album_id). Migrations.

tasks.title: Implement Email Signup (Brevo Integration Already Exists)
tasks.description: Verify Brevo integration from Phase 0 works. Test end-to-end email capture from landing page → Brevo contact list. Add confirmation email template.

tasks.title: Add About Page (Bio, Credits, Contact Info)
tasks.description: About Allyson (bio), album credits (musicians, producers), contact form (name, email, message → Brevo).

tasks.title: Implement Blog Workflow (Allyson Writes → Approval → Publish)
tasks.description: Semi-automatic blog workflow: Allyson submits post (markdown or rich text), Serigne approves, post appears on site. Admin panel blog editor.

tasks.title: Add Search + Filter on Blog (by tag, date range)
tasks.description: Blog search (title/content), tag filtering, date range picker. Client-side or server-side depending on volume.

tasks.title: Implement Social Media Share Buttons (Blog + Gallery)
tasks.description: Share buttons (Twitter/X, Facebook, LinkedIn) on blog posts and gallery images. OG meta tags for rich previews.

tasks.title: Add Image Optimization + CDN Setup (Cloudinary or Netlify Images)
tasks.description: Optimize all images for web (responsive srcset, AVIF/WebP formats). Consider Cloudinary or Netlify's built-in image optimization.

tasks.title: Implement Analytics Tracking (GA4 Already Configured)
tasks.description: Verify GA4 from Phase 0 is tracking correctly. Add custom events (album view, blog read, email signup, admin login). Set up funnels.

tasks.title: SEO Audit + Schema.org Verification (Phase 0 A-rated, enhance for Phase 1)
tasks.description: Verify Schema.org JSON-LD for blog posts, albums, images. Ensure all pages have proper meta tags (title, description, keywords). Run PageSpeed Insights.

tasks.title: Add Dark Mode Toggle (Accessibility + UX Enhancement)
tasks.description: CSS custom properties for dark mode. Persist user preference in localStorage. Prefers-color-scheme media query fallback.

tasks.title: Performance Testing + Optimization (Lighthouse, WebVitals)
tasks.description: Run Lighthouse, measure Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS). Optimize based on results (code splitting, lazy loading, caching).

tasks.title: Write Unit Tests (Landing, Blog, Gallery Components)
tasks.description: Jest + React Testing Library for LitElement components. 80%+ coverage for core pages. Admin panel auth tests.

tasks.title: E2E Testing (Cypress or Playwright)
tasks.description: Critical user journeys (landing → email signup, view album, admin login → upload, read blog post). 10+ test scenarios.

tasks.title: Security Audit (OWASP Top 10, Auth Flow Review)
tasks.description: Review JWT auth, SQL injection (Prisma safe), XSS (sanitize markdown), CSRF, rate limiting. Penetration test basics.

tasks.title: Generalize Admin Panel for Multi-Artist (Phase 2 MVP)
tasks.description: Extend admin interface to support multiple artists. Role-based auth (admin, artist, viewer). Artist dashboard for self-service album uploads.

tasks.title: Build Artist Profile Pages (Directory of Artists)
tasks.description: Directory of all artists on platform, individual artist profile pages (bio, albums, links). Enable Allyson to invite collaborators.

tasks.title: Implement Collaborative Features (Comments, Likes, Playlists)
tasks.description: Album/song comments, like counts, user playlists, social features. Requires user authentication beyond admin.

tasks.title: Add Phonosophie Integration (If Allyson Interested)
tasks.description: Embed Phonosophie collection into artist bios or album notes. Linguistic analysis of song titles. Deferred per BBBA decision.
tasks.required_by: Phase 2 or Phase 3 (post validation with Allyson)

tasks.title: Video Integration (Music Videos, Behind-the-Scenes)
tasks.description: Embed YouTube videos or self-hosted video player. Video library. Only if Allyson has video content.

tasks.title: Add Podcast Feed (if applicable)
tasks.description: Publish blog posts or interviews as RSS feed. MP3 hosting if Allyson does interviews.

Phase_0_Complete.description: Multi-page architecture, Brevo email, GA4, Schema.org A-rated, AI-crawlability audit pass

Phase_1_MVP.description: Landing page, blog, gallery, admin panel (admin-only), email signup, analytics, SEO, performance optimization

Phase_2_Scaling.description: Multi-artist platform, artist profiles, collaborative features, Phonosophie integration
Phase_2_Scaling.estimated_start: Post Phase 1 MVP validation (6–8 weeks out)

sequence: TOTAL CRITICAL PATH: ~48h (32h w/ aggressive parallelization)

immediate_actions: Resolve BLOCKER-001 (Service Topology) — Serigne + Opus session, 3h
Resolve BLOCKER-002 (Album Upload scope) — Serigne, 1h decision
Start PHASE_1_004 (navigation) — foundational, unblocked, parallel to blockers

Sprint_2.focus: Blog + gallery pages + admin panel foundation

Sprint_3.focus: Blog workflow + enhancement features (dark mode, search, sharing)

Sprint_5.focus: E2E testing + security audit + launch prep

resource_allocation.Opus_4_6: BLOCKER-001 (architecture), PHASE_2_001 (future scaling design) — 3h this sprint

φ_harmonic_alignment.efficiency: Critical path 32h achievable with clear sequencing; total 98h realistic over 5 weeks
